testBoundary.transport: Real system SSH to the explicitly authorized tools alias; every remote write stayed under the owned temporary root.
testBoundary.runtime: Real pinned ZCode Node services, deployed server, CLI, PTY, model registry, task service, Read tool and native terminal event. No HTTP-only or UI-only substitute.
testBoundary.model: Scripted authenticated loopback OpenAI-compatible SSE fake model. Every inference request used the canonical remoteModelRoute. The tool response containing the actual owned probe file marker was observed in the subsequent model input.
testBoundary.credentials: Only fixture credentials and the remote relay's random credential were used. The private desktop gateway token was not provisioned to the remote provider. No original ZCode account, private API key or user project was read.
testBoundary.deployment: The prior full native deployment gate passed. This invocation independently compared the actual deployed server, Node, PTY, CLI and three search executables to all seven current resource hashes before reusing them.
testBoundary.scope: Validates one Linux x64 SSH host with a compatible glibc and the owned temporary project. Does not claim a real model's coding quality, paid model access, WSL, Docker, ARM or older-glibc execution was tested.
